SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
DataSplit
Splits an ARFF dataset into three subsets: training (train), development (dev) and test.
EmailLoader
Loads the text files of the emails and converts them to the ARFF format that Weka can use.
EmailVectorizerAndSelector
Vectorizes the text data and selects the most relevant attributes, for email classification (spam vs legitimate).
Evaluate
Evaluates the quality of a classifier with two methods: Cross Validation and Hold-Out.
ExperimentLogger
Manages the automatic logging of experiments, saving the relevant information of each run to a file.
FilterSerializationHelper
Helper class to serialize (save) and deserialize (load) Weka filters.
GetModel
Optimizes the parameters (fine-tuning) of the Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) algorithm.
Predict
Makes predictions on new emails using a trained classifier (MLP model).
TestModel
Performs the final evaluation of a trained model on an independent test dataset (blind test).
TextNormalizer
Custom Weka filter that normalizes email text.
